### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**4** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-type-schema.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-type-schema.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e3bdc748841f8ec72aedc3d795227273f25c6baa` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `6e99b789a2fd75a1701aec73b438164d1e9e8dfb` — the merge of head `da349440cb45726b4ac08f1bbaad9ab7802f473c` into base `e3bdc748841f8ec72aedc3d795227273f25c6baa`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 6e99b789a2fd75a1701aec73b438164d1e9e8dfb && git checkout 6e99b789a2fd75a1701aec73b438164d1e9e8dfb
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin e3bdc748841f8ec72aedc3d795227273f25c6baa da349440cb45726b4ac08f1bbaad9ab7802f473c && git checkout -B drift-repro e3bdc748841f8ec72aedc3d795227273f25c6baa && git merge --no-ff da349440cb45726b4ac08f1bbaad9ab7802f473c

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e3bdc748841f8ec72aedc3d795227273f25c6baa
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `da349440cb45726b4ac08f1bbaad9ab7802f473c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/metadata-protocol/src/unauthorable-nodes.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-type-schema.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/unauthorable-nodes.test.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-unauthorable-columns.test.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts + read, not reviewed: packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-protection.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/mergeServerFields.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/clientValidation.ts, docs/adr/0010-metadata-protection-model.md, AGENTS.md. Not reviewed: the changeset.

Read: card #35879 (body and all four comments: triage 7045236144, claim 7235283324, amendment 7235462308, dev report 7236382919), the PR body, the net diff against the merge base `7605e0c9`, and the check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The strip predicate.** `stripUnauthorableProperties` now drops a property when its node admits no instance OR its key is in `PLATFORM_STAMPED_KEYS`, and in both cases only as an entry of a schema node's own `properties` map and only when the sibling `required` does not name it. Right. The key set is `Object.keys(MetadataProtectionFields)`, which on `main` is exactly `_lock`, `_lockReason`, `_lockSource`, `_provenance`, `_packageId`, `_packageVersion`, `_lockDocsUrl`; the unit pin spells the seven out, so a key added to the envelope later turns that pin red rather than leaving the description silently.
- **Every depth.** The walk already recurses through schema nodes, schema arrays (`anyOf` and the like) and the name-to-schema maps (`properties`, `$defs`, `patternProperties`, `dependentSchemas`, `definitions`), so the new class reaches `object.fields.additionalProperties`, the `$defs` entries and each `view` arm with no new traversal. Right. A stamped NAME as a `$defs` entry or under a data keyword (`default`, `const`, `enum`, `examples`) is not read; pinned.
- **Nothing an author may write is dropped.** The predicate is by name, so the guarantee rests on the new over-drop guard: for every served type and both derivations, every `properties` entry named like a stamp must equal the envelope's own derived node and sit where all seven are spread. Right, and it is the correct guard for a name predicate. `protection`, the authoring spelling, is a different key and stays served.
- **Both derivation arms.** `toJsonSchemaSafe` passes the output derivation and the authoring retry through the same strip; `HAND_CRAFTED_SCHEMAS` lists none of the seven. Right. `getMetaTypes()` is the one producer; `GET /meta/types`, the runtime `/metadata` listing and the MCP door's `typeContractOf` all answer from it, so the lean contract follows without a second rule.
- **The degeneracy pin.** `retiredTopLevelCount` adds back tombstones and stamped keys, so each pinned declared total keeps measuring the type's declared key count. Right: the totals are unchanged in the diff, and the baseline is still stripped with the emitter's own function.
- **The existing over-drop guard** (`#17502`) now explains a removal by either class and keeps the `dashboard` tombstone ledger on tombstones alone. Right.
- **Public surface.** No export is added to the package index (`unauthorable-nodes.ts` is not re-exported); no file under `packages/spec` is in the diff. The public change is the served JSON Schema of each type, which lists seven fewer keys per envelope.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch, `Clause-②: no (narrowing ...)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, with an `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker. This matches the diff: no schema key, accepted value or metadata type is added, removed or renamed, so the kind is `none` and `none` takes `patch` (AGENTS.md, changeset rule); the amendment 7235462308 corrected the claim's `narrowed` and the diff bears the correction out. The `(narrowing)` arm is the conservative reading of a description that shrinks; it is what owes this review and the battery. `Check Changeset`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` concluded success on this head.

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — judged correct for the served-description change.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 7236382919 carries `open_questions: []` and `out_of_scope_findings: []`. Nothing to answer.
- Check-runs on `da349440`: 0 failure. One `Check Changeset` re-run (started 08:06Z, after the PR body edit) was still in progress when read; the earlier run of the same check on this head concluded success.
- The dogfood battery owed by the `(narrowing)` arm is evidenced by the dev's reading alone (490 files, 4144 passed, exit 0 at this head): CI's `Dogfood Regression Gate` matrix was skipped on this diff and only its aggregate concluded success. The landing gate reads the battery; this record does not re-judge it.
- SQL push-down: the diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join. Nothing to flag.
- The card's third done-when item is with the owner seat by agreement and is outside this record.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing against the published spec on `main`: every site that spreads the envelope labels it internal in the spec's own words (`object.zod.ts`, `field.zod.ts`, `view.zod.ts`: "runtime protection envelope (internal — set by the loader)"), ADR-0010 Phase 4.3 names `protection` as the public author surface, and `skills/objectstack-mcp-build` tells a door client to write only the keys the contract shows. A description whose stated job is "what an author MAY write" was offering keys the spec calls internal. Dropping them makes the spec's own posture real at the description; it takes no declared authoring capability away at the consumer, and no Zod shape moves, so code-package source typing is as it was.

Omit, not `readOnly`: holds against the converter's convention. The module's one existing way to say "not part of the offer" is to drop the property, and the consumers read the KEY SET (Studio's column headers and form fields, the lean contract's key list), which a `readOnly` annotation would not change without a second rule in each reader.

Tried to break it at the readers:

- Studio reads the stamps off item BODIES (`ResourceListPage`, `QuickFind`, `PermissionMatrixEditor`, the previews, `anchors.ts` `listExtraColumns`), never off the served schema's `properties`. Nothing lost.
- `clientValidation.ts` judges with the bundled Zod schemas, not the served JSON Schema. Unaffected.
- `mergeServerFields.ts` grafts server-only properties into a curated form; fewer served keys can only graft less. Unaffected.
- `SchemaForm.tsx` `valueContradictions` ranks union branches by keys a closed branch does not declare. For the `view` root this is neutral: all four members are closed (`closeWireMember`, `strictObject`) and all four spread the envelope, so a served body's stamps now count equally against each.
- The MCP door's `typeContractOf` projects the served entry; `runtimeServesMetadataType` and the two runtime listings read type names or pass the entry through. Unaffected.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract; each is left as an accepted deviation or a follow-up card, since a fix outside the prose faces moves the head):

- N1 (nit) — `PLATFORM_STAMPED_KEYS` is `Object.freeze(new Set(...))`. Freezing a `Set` does not stop `.add()` or `.delete()`; the jsdoc's "a caller cannot widen or narrow" and the unit pin's `Object.isFrozen` assert less than they say. What actually protects the set is the `ReadonlySet` type and the module not being re-exported from the package index.
- N2 (nit) — the runtime lean-contract pin's `view` half has no positive control: it asserts `arms.length` above zero and a regex over the whole reply, so if the lean form ever falls to a level without `alternatives` the regex passes on a reply that lists no arm keys at all. The `object` half (root and the `fields/additionalProperties` drill) is controlled, the card asked for one type, and the metadata-protocol "dark" pin covers `view` at every depth on the payload the door reads.
- N3 (nit) — tombstones and stamps differ in one respect the "same way" wording passes over: a tombstoned key appears in no body, while a stamped key appears in served bodies. On a closed node the description now omits keys a read body carries, so a reader that scores or validates a read body against the served schema counts them as undeclared. Checked neutral for the `view` root (above); nested unions in other types were not enumerated. A Studio pin on union-branch choice for a stamped body would close it.
- N4 (nit) — the module comment's "none of them is an author's to write" is exact for the surface this payload describes; ADR-0010 §3.3 still shows `_lock` in a code package's source and the mixin's jsdoc says it exposes the envelope "to its TS authors". The comment would be exact with "through this surface".

## 维护者速读
- **改了什么：** 平台对外给出的「这类配置能写哪些字段」说明（Studio 和 AI 助手都读它，`/meta/types` 和 MCP 草稿入口的精简说明），以前混进了 7 个由平台自己盖章的内部字段（锁定状态、来源、所属包等）。现在这份说明在各层都不再列出它们。
- **影响：** 只改对外描述，不改任何校验规则，也不改保存、发布、读取。以前能保存的内容现在照样能保存；AI 助手按说明「只写列出的字段」时，不会再被引导去写这些内部字段。`protection` 这个作者可写的块照常列出。
- **请你留意：** 这是对外描述的缩窄（narrowing），按规则走你批准。卡上「保存侧实测」那一项已私下交安全席处理，PR 里只写一行说明，不公开细节。
- **审核：** 契约审核（最高档）PASS（7236449234），没有必须改或建议改的项，四处小瑕疵按已接受偏差记录；dogfood 全量在本 head 上通过。席位 L1 ACCEPT 在本评论前一条。
- **要你做什么：** 需要你批准后才能合并。撤回这一次合并即恢复原样。
